Source: Brucellosis is a highly contagious zoonosis affecting human and almost all domestic species.

Hausa: Cutar burosolosis wani nau'in cuta mai iya yaɗuwa tsakanin mutane da dabbobi ce da take da saurin yaɗuwa wadda take shafar mutane da kusan dukkanin nau'o’in dabbobin gida.

Source: This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) related to brucellosis at human-animal interface and to determine the risk factors for human infection in the Nile Delta, Egypt.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwagenderera okwekenneenya amagezi, entewala n’ebikolebwa (KAPs) ebyekwanya ku bulusela mu nkolagana y’omuntu-n’ensolo wamu n’okulaba ensonga z’obulabe mu bantu abakoseddwa mu Nile Delta, Misiri.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ní èrò láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò Ìmọ̀, ìhùwàsí àti Ìṣe (KAP) tí ó jẹ mọ́ burusẹlíọ́sisì tí ó ń wáyé látàrí àjọṣepò tó ńwáyé láàárín ènìyàn àti ẹrànko àti láti wo àwọn ewu tí ó le è ṣokùnfà àkóràn mọ́ àwọn ènìyàn ní Nile Delta, Egypt.
Zulu: Lolucwaningo luhlose ukuthola ukuthi ulwazi, indlela yokubheka izimo,kanye nosikompilo (KAP) kuyabasiza yini abantu ukuba bakwazi ukuqapha ngesifo se-brucellosis esichaphazeleka ngokuthintana komuntu nesilwane, ukuze kutholakale izimbangela ezinobungozi ezibhebhethekisa le sifo eNayili yeDeta ezweni laseGibhithe.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi niyya don tantance ilimi da halaye da kuma ayyuka (KAP) da suke da alaƙa da cutar burosolosis a mahaɗar ɗan’adam da dabba da kuma tantance abubuwan haɗari ga kamuwa da ɗan’adam a cikin Kogin Nilu, na ƙasar Masar.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di ikemišeditše go sekaseka tsebo, maikutlo le ditiro (KAP) tša go amana le brucellosis ka kamanong ya batho le diphoofolo le go tseba mabaka a kotsi ao a bakago phetetšo go batho ka Nile Delta, Egypt.

Source: A matched case-control study was conducted at the main fever hospitals located in 6 governorates in the Nile Delta, Egypt between June 2014 and June 2016.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okw’okugeraageranyizaako kwakolebwa ku malwaliro g’omusujja amakulu agali mu bitundu by’obukulembeze 6 mu Nile Delta, Misiri wakati w’Ogwomukaaga 2014 n’Ogwomukaaga 2016.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí ajẹmọ́ ìṣàkóso-irúfẹ́ àìsàn wáyé ní ilé ìwòsàn ìtọ́jú àìsàn ìrànmọ́ni tí ó wà ní ìpínlẹ̀ mẹ́fà (6) ní Nile Delta, Egypt láàárín Okúdù 2014 àti Okúdù 2016.
Zulu: Ucwaningo i-match control study laqhutshwa ezibhedlela zomkhuhlane ezi-6 ezenkulu kusukela ngo-Juni 2014 kuya ku-juni 2016.
Hausa: An gudanar da wani bincike mai kwatanta masu cuta da marasa cuta da ya dace a manyan asibitocin zazzaɓi da suke cikin larduna 6 a cikin Kogin Nilu, na ƙasar Masar a tsakanin watan Yuni na shekarar 2014 da kuma watan Yuni na shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tšeo di nyalantšhitšwego tša taolo ya malwetši di dirilwe ka dipetleleng tša go alafa balwetši ba letadi tšeo di lego ka go makala a taolo a 6 ka Nile Delta, Egypt magareng ga June 2014 le June 2016.
Amharic: በናይል ዴልታ፣ ግብፅ በ6 ግዛቶች ውስጥ በሚገኙት ዋና ትኩሳት ሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ ከሰኔ 2014 እስከ ሰኔ 2016 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ተመሳሳይ የጉዳይ-ቁጥጥር ጥናት ተካሄዷል።

Source: Face-to-face interviews with cases and controls was done using a structured questionnaire.
Luganda: Okubuuza ebibuuzo ebya maaso ku maaso ku banoonyerezebwako n’abagereaageranyizibwako kwakolebwa nga bakozesa olukalala lw’ebibuuzo.
Yoruba: Ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò ojúkojú wáyé lórí àwọn irúfẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àti ọ̀nà ìṣàkóso wọn pèlú ìlò Àtòjọ ìbéèrè tí ó tọ̀nà.
Zulu: Kwenziwa inhlolovo yobuso nobuso phakathi kwabacwaningi nabantu olwalungabo ocwaningo, okwakuyiqembu elikhungethwe isifo nelalingenaso nhlobo.Ucwaningo lwaqutshwa ngokusebenzisa ama-questionaire.
Hausa: An gudanar da tambayoyin baki-da-baki tare da batutuwa da kuma sarrafawa ta amfani da tsararrun tambayoyi.
Northern Sotho: Dipotsološo tša batho ka sebele tša mabapi le diphetetšo le taolo ya bolwetši di dirilwe ka go šomiša dipotšišo tša dinyakišišo tšeo di beakantšwego peleng.

Source: Differences in proportions of KAP variables among the cases and controls were evaluated by Pearson’s Chi square test and a p value <0.05 was set as a level of significance.
Luganda: Enjawulo mu bigero by’ebikyukakyuka bya KAP mu banoonyerezebwako n’abagereaageranyizibwako byekalirizibwa na kukozesa Pearson’s Chi square test era p value <0.05 yategekebwa ng’ekigero ekigeraageranyizibwako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àmúlò ìdànwò Pearson’s Chi square láti ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ ìyàtọ̀ nínú ìdá àìṣedéédé KAP láàárín àwọn irúfẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àti ọ̀nà ìṣàkóso, p value <0.05 ni wọ́n fi ṣe ìda ìpele ìṣekókó.
Zulu: Ukwehlukana kwenani lolwazi ngokwe-KAP phakathi kwabacwanigwa lwahlolwa nge-Pearson square test kanye ne-ap value <0.05 eyasethwa yabekwa esigabeni esifanelekile.
Hausa: An ƙimanta bambance-bambance a cikin ma'auni na masu sauyi na KAP a tsakanin batutuwa da kuma sarrafawa ta gwajin murabba'in Chi na Pearson kuma an saita p value <0.05 a matsayin matakin mahimmanci.
Northern Sotho: Diphapano ka ga bontši bja difarologano tša KAP gareng ga diphetetšo le ka fao bolwetši bo laolwago ka gona di ile tša sekasekwa ka go diriša teko ya Pearson’s Chi square gomme p value <0.05 e ile ya bewa maemong a bohlokwa.
Amharic: ከጉዳዮች እና ቁጥጥሮች መካከል የእ.አ.ተ ተለዋዋጮች የተመጣጣኝ ልዩነቶች በፔርሰን ቺ ካሬ ቴስት ተገምግመዋል እና p እሴት <0.05 እንደ አስፈላጊ ደረጃ ተቀምጧል።

Source: A total of 217 cases and 434 controls matched for age, gender and sociodemographic characteristics were enrolled and interviewed.

Source: In total, 40.7% of the participants owned animals in their households and lived in shared accommodation with animals [48.8% of cases vs 36.9% of controls; (p= 0.003)].
Luganda: Abeetabi abawera 40.7% baalina ebisolo mu maka gaabwe era nga baali basula mu nju n’ebisolo [abanoonyerezebwako 48.8% ne 36.9% abageraageranyizibwako; (p= 0.003)].
Yoruba: Ní àpapọ̀, ìdá 40.7% àwọn akópa ní wọ́n ní àwọn ẹrankó ní inú ilé wọ́n, tí wọ́n sì ń pín ilé gbé pẹ̀lú ẹrankó [48.8% irúfẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ sí 36.9% ọ̀nà ìṣàkóso (p= 0.003)].
Zulu: Imiphumela yaveza ukuthi inani eliphelele labantu abangama-40.7% babefuye izilwane emizini yabo futhi bahlala nazo ezindlini [ama-48.8% am-acase vs ama-36.9% ama-controls; (p= 0.003)].
Hausa: A cikin duka, kashi 40.7% na mahalarta sun mallaki dabbobi a cikin gidajensu kuma suna zaune a cikin gida tare da dabbobin [48.8% na batutuwa da kashi 36.9% na sarrafawa; (p= 0.003)].

Zulu: Kwavela ukuthi kubantu ababeyinxenye yocwaningo phakathi kwalabo abagulayo nabangaguli abangama 67.4% bebonke bengahlukanisiwe [(ama-70.0% of the cases vs ama- 66.1% of the controls) (p = 0.315)] kwavela ukuthi bonke ngokwehluka kweqoqa abakulo nenani babengake bezwe ngesifo sebrucellosis.

Northern Sotho: Mafelelong, 67.4% ya bakgathatema [(70.0% ya diphetetšo ge go bapetšwa le 66.1% ya ditaolo) (p = 0.315)] ga se ba ka ba kwa ka ga bolwetši bja brucellosis.

Source: Brucellosis, which can be passed from animals to humans, causes symptoms like fever, weakness, and weight loss in humans.
Luganda: Bulusela, obulwadde obuyinza okutambuzibwa okuva ku bisolo okudda ku bantu, buleeta obubonero nga omusujja, obunafu, n’okukogga mu bantu.
Yoruba: Burusẹlíọ́sisì, èyí tí ó le è ràn mọ́ ènìyàn láti ara ẹranko, máa ń fa àwọn àmì àìsàn bíi ibà, àìlera, ìdínku ìtóbi ní ara àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: I i-Brucellosis etholakala ngokuchaphazelana phakathi kwabantu nezilwane, ibonakala ngezimpawu zokuphathwa imfiva, ukuba buthakathaka emzimbeni ,kanye nokuncipha kwesikalo somzimba.
Hausa: Cutar burosolosis, wadda za a iya yaɗa ta daga dabbobi zuwa mutane, tana haifar da alamu kamar zazzaɓi da rauni da rage nauyi a cikin mutane.
Northern Sotho: Brucellosis, we lego bolwetši bjo bo ka fetetšwago batho go tšwa diphoofolong, bo baka maswao a go swana le go fiša ga mmele, go hloka maatla, le go sesefala mmeleng ga batho.
Amharic: ከእንስሳት ወደ ሰው የሚተላለፈው ብሩሴሎሲስ እንደ ትኩሳት፣ ድካም፣ እና ክብደት መቀነስ ያሉ ምልክቶች በሰዎች ላይ ያስከትላል።

Source: In farm animals like cattle and goats, the disease can cause animals to abort their young and produce less milk.
Luganda: Mu nsolo z’oku faamu nga ente n’embuzi, obulwadde obwo busobola okuleetera ensolo okuvaamu amawako ate n’okuvaamu amata amatono.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn eranko tí wọ́n wà ní oko, bíi màlúù àti ewúrẹ, àìsàn le è mú kí oyún yọ̀ lára ẹranko, kí wọ́n si má le è gbé ìwọ̀n wàrà tí ó jáde.
Zulu: Emapulazini ezilwane ezifana nezinkomo kanye nezimbuzi, lesi sifo sibonakala ngokuthi izilwane zihushukelwe izisu, ziphinde zikhiqize ubisi oluncane.
Hausa: A cikin dabbobin gona kamar shanu da awaki, cutar tana iya sa dabbobi su zubar da cikin ’ya’yansu kuma su samar da madara kaɗan.
Northern Sotho: Ka diphofolong tša dipolaseng tša go swana le dikgomo le dipudi, bolwetši bjo bo ka baka gore diphoofolo di folotše le go tšweletša maswi a mannyane.
Amharic: እንደ ከብትና ፍየል ባሉ የርቢ እንስሳት፣ በሽታው እንስሳት ግልገሎቻቸውን እንዲያስወርዱ እና አነስተኛ ወተት እንዲታለቡ ያደርጋል።

Source: In Egypt, the government has implemented a national programme to control the disease, but the rate of animal infection is still very high.
Luganda: E Misiri, gavumenti etaddewo pulogulaamu y’eggwanga lyonna okuziyiza obulwadde obwo, naye ekigero ensolo kwe zirwalira kiri waggulu.
Yoruba: Ní Egypt, àwọn ìjọba ti ṣe ètò ìmúṣẹ láti ṣe ìṣàkóso àwọn àìsàn, ṣùgbọ́n òṣùwọ̀n àwọn àìsàn ìrànmọ́ni láti ara ẹrànko pọ̀ púpọ̀ síbẹ̀.
Zulu: Ezweni lase-Egypty uhulumeni wethule uhlelo likazwelonke lokulawula lesi sifo , kodwa namanje inani lezilwane elikhungethwe ilesi sifo lisaphezulu kakhulu.
Hausa: A Masar, gwamnati ta aiwatar da wani shiri na ƙasa don shawo kan cutar, amma har yanzu yawan kamuwa da cututtukan dabbobi yana da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka Egypt, mmušo o phethagaditše lenaneo la bosetšhaba la go laola bolwetši bjo, eupša kelo ya phetetšo ya diphoofolo e sa le godimo kudu.
Amharic: በግብፅ፣ መንግሥት በሽታውን ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ብሔራዊ መርሃ ግብር ተግባራዊ አድርጓል፣ ነገር ግን የእንስሳት ኢንፌክሽን መጠን አሁንም በጣም ከፍተኛ ነው።

Source: Many people also still contract Brucellosis, making it important for scientists to understand how and why the disease is being transmitted.
Luganda: Era n’abantu bangi ddala abakwatibwa bulusela, era kino ne kyongera okulaga nti kyamugaso bannassaayansi okutegeera engeri n’ensonga eziviirako obulwadde obwo okusaasaana.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn ṣì ń kó àrun burusẹlíọ́sisì, ó sì jẹ́ kí ó ṣe pàtàkì fún àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì láti ní òye ọ̀nà àti ìdí tí àrun yìí fi ń ràn mọ́ ènìyàn.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi basachaphazeleka nge-Brucellosis, lokhu kwenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ososayensi bathole imbangela yokusabalala kwale sifo.
Hausa: Har ila yau, mutane da yawa suna kamuwa da cutar Burosolosis, wanda ya sa ya zama abu mai mahimmanci ga masana kimiyya su fahimci yadda da kuma dalilin da ya sa ake yaɗa cutar.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba bantši ba sa fetelwa ke Brucellosis, gomme se sa dira gore go be bohlokwa gore bašomi ba tša mahlale ba kwešiše ka fao bolwetši bo fetela bjang le gona ka lebaka la eng.
Amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች አሁንም ብሩሴሎሲስ ይይዛቸዋል፣ ይህም ለሳይንቲስቶች በሽታው እንዴት እና ለምን እንደሚተላለፍ ለመረዳት አስፈላጊ ያደርገዋል።

Source: In this study, the researchers therefore wanted to find out how much people know about the disease, and whether they take the appropriate precautions when working with animals that might carry it.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayala okuzuula abantu gye bajja okumanya obulwadde obwo, era n’okumanya oba nga bafaayo okwetangira bwe baba nga batabagana n’ensolo eziyinza okuba n’obulwadde.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti ṣe àwárí bí àwọn ènìyàn ti mọ̀ tó nípa àrùn, àti bóyá wọ́n máa ń ṣe ohun tí ó tọ́ ní ìgbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n le è kó ní àrun yìí lára.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bebehlose ukuthola ukuthi abantu banolwazi olungakanani ngalesi sifo, kanye nokubheka ukuthi bayazilandela yini izindlela zokuzivekela eziphephile uma bethinta izilwane elitholakala kuzo leli gciwane.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so ne su gano yawan mutanen da suka san cutar, da kuma ko suna ɗaukar matakan da suka dace yayin aiki da dabbobin da za su iya ɗauka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši le ge go le bjale ba ile ba nyaka go tseba gore ke batho ba bakae bao ba tsebago ka ga bolwetši bjo, le ge eba ba tšea magato a maleba ge ba hlokometše diphoofolo tšeo di ka rwalago bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ስለበሽታው ሰዎች ምን ያህል እንደሚያውቁ፣ እና በሽታውን ሊሸከሙ ከሚችሉ እንስሳት ጋር ሲሰሩ ተገቢውን ጥንቃቄ እንደወሰዱ ለማወቅ ይፈልጋሉ።

Source: They were also interested in learning how different factors, like improper food preparation and animal care techniques, affect the chance of someone contracting the disease.
Luganda: Era bannassaayansi baayala okumanya engeri ensonga ez’enjawulo nga entegeka y’emmere embi n’endabirira y’ensolo, gye bikosaamu omukisa gw’omuntu okukwatibwa obulwadde obwo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ní ìfẹ́ sí kíkọ́ nípa bí onírúurú èròjà, bíi ìpèsè oúnjẹ́ ní ọ̀nà àìtọ̀ àti ọgbọ́n ìtọ́jú ẹranko, ṣe ń ní ipa lórí bí ènìyàn ṣe le è kó àrùn náà.
Zulu: Bebehlose nokuthola ukuthi ngabe izimo ezihlukahlukene ezifana nokuphathwa kokudla ngendlela engamukelekile, kanye nezidlela zokunakekela izilwane zanamthelela muni ekutheni umuntu achaphazeleke ngalesi sifo.
Hausa: Suna kuma sha'awar koyon yadda abubuwa daban-daban, kamar shirya abinci mara kyau da dabarun kula da dabbobi, suke shafar damar wani ya kamu da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba be ba na le kghahlego ya go tseba mabaka ao a farologanego, a go swana le go dira dijo ka fao go sego maleb le mekgwa ya tlhokomelo ya diphoofolo ye e sego ya maleba, go ama kgonagalo ya gore motho yo mongwe a fetelwe ke bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: እንደ ተገቢ ያልሆነ የምግብ ዝግጅት እና የእንስሳት እንክብካቤ ዘዴዎች ያሉ የተለያዩ ምክንያቶች፣ አንድ ሰው በበሽታው የመያዝ እድልን እንዴት እንደሚጎዱ ለማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

Source: Over a period of two years, the researchers interviewed 217 people who were in hospital with a diagnosis of Brucellosis.
Luganda: Mu bbanga lya myaka ebiri, abanoonyereza baabuuza abantu 217 abaali mu malwaliro nga basangiddwa nga balina Bulusela.
Yoruba: Láàárín ọdún méji tí ó kọjá, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún 217 ènìyàn tí wọ́n wà ní ilé ìwòsàn, látàrí àrùn burusẹlíọ́sisì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bachitha iminyaka emibili benza inhlolovo yezingulini ezingama-217 ezazingenele ukuzolashelwa isifo se-Brucellosis esibhedlela.
Hausa: A tsawon shekaru biyu, masu binciken sun yi hira da mutane guda 217 da suke asibiti tare da gano cutar ta Burosolosis.
Northern Sotho: Mo mengwageng ye mebedi, banyakišiši ba ile ba botšiša batho ba 217 dipotšišo bao ba bego ba le ka sepetlele bao ba bego ba phekotšwe gore ba na le Brucellosis.
Amharic: በሁለት ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ለብሩሴሎሲስ ምርመራ በሆስፒታል ውስጥ ላሉ 217 ሰዎች ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

Source: They also interviewed another 434 “controls”, or people who did not have Brucellosis, but were at the hospital for other reasons.
Luganda: Era baabuuza abantu abalala “abageraageranyizibwako” 434 oba abantu abataalina Bulusela, naye nga bali mu ddwaliro lwa nsonga ndala.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni wọ́n fi ọ̀rọ̀ wa àwọn 434 mìíràn lẹ́nuwò lórí ìṣàkóso, tàbí àwọn ènìyàn tí kò ní burusẹlíọ́sisì, ṣùgbọ́n tí wọ́n wà ní ilé ìwòsàn fún ìdí mìíràn.
Zulu: Baphinde benza inhlolovo kubantu abangam- 434 ababengazele ukuzolashelwa isifo seBrucellosis esibhedlela, kepha beze ngezizathu ezihlukile.
Hausa: Sun kuma yi hira da wasu "masu sarrafawa" guda 434, ko mutanen da ba su da cutar Burosolosis, amma suna asibiti saboda wasu dalilai.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba botšiša bathi ba bangwe bao ba “laolwago” ba 434, goba batho bao ba bego ba se na Brucellosis, eupša ba be ba le ka sepetlele ka mabaka a mangwe.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ሌሎች 434 "መቆጣጠሪያዎች" ወይም ብሩሴሎሲስ የሌላቸውን፣ ነገር ግን በሌሎች ምክንያቶች በሆስፒታል ውስጥ የነበሩ ሰዎችን ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

Source: This type of study, called a case-control study, allows researchers to pinpoint factors that might affect the chances of someone contracting the disease.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okw’ekika kino kuyitibwa okunoonyereza-okw’okugeza-n’okugeraageranya, kuyamba abanoonyereza okusonga ku nsonga eziyinza okukosa emikisa z’omuntu okukwatibwa obulwadde obwo.
Yoruba: Irúfẹ́ iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí, tí a ń pè ní Ìwádìí ajẹmọ́ ìṣàkóso-irúfẹ́ àìsàn, fi àyè gba àwọn olùwádìí láti sọ ní pàtó àwọn èròjà tí ó ṣe é ṣe láti ṣe ìpalára fún bí ènìyàn ṣe le è kó àrùn náà.
Zulu: Loluhlobo lochaningo olubizwa ngokuthi i-case study control, livumela abacwaningi ukuba bakwazi ukuqangula izinto ezingaba imbangela yokuthi umuntu achaphazeleke ngesifo.
Hausa: Irin wannan binciken, wanda ake kira bincike mai kwatanta masu cuta da marasa cuta, yana ba wa masu bincike damar nuna abubuwan da za su iya shafar yiwuwar wani ya kamu da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Mohuta wo wa dinyakišišo, wo o bitšwago dinyakišišo tša go laola bolwetši, o dumelela banyakišišo go hlatha mabaka ao a ka amago dibaka tša gore motho yo mongwe a fetelwe ke bolwetši.
Amharic: ኬዝ-ቁጥጥር ጥናት ተብሎ የሚጠራው፣ ይህ ዓይነቱ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎች አንድ ሰው በበሽታው የመያዝ እድልን ሊያዙ የሚችሉ ነገሮችን እንዲጠቁሙ ያስችላቸዋል።

Source: The people being interviewed were asked about their knowledge of the disease, whether they had regular contact with animals, their knowledge of proper animal care practices, and which dairy products they usually consumed.
Luganda: Abantu abaabuuzibwa ebibuuzo baabuuzibwa ku bye bamanyi ku bulwadde, oba nga baali batabagana nnyo n’ebisolo, obumanyi bwawe ku ndabirira y’ensolo ennungi, n’ebikolebwa mu mata bye batera okulya oba okunywa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n bèèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n fi ọ̀rọ̀ wá lẹ́nuwò nípa ìmọ̀ tí wọ́n lórí àìsàn náà, bóya wọ́n máa ń ní àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹrnko lóòrèkóòre, ìmọ̀ wọn nípa ọ̀nà ìṣètọ́jú ẹranko bí ó ti tọ́, àti irúfẹ́ ọ̀nà ìṣẹ̀tọ́jú wàrà ẹranko, irúfẹ́ àwọn ohun tí ó jẹ mọ wàrà ẹranko tí wọ́n máa ń jẹ.
Zulu: Abantu akwakuthathwa inhlolovo kubo babe buzwa ngolwazi abanalo bayelana nalesi sifo.Babebuzu ukuthi bajwayele yini ukuthintana nezilwane, babuzwa nangolwazi olufanele lokunakekela izilwane, nangokuthi imiphi imkhiqizo yobisi ababevamise ukuyidla.
Hausa: An tambayi mutanen da aka zanta da su game da iliminsu game da cutar, ko suna hulɗa da dabbobi akai-akai, sanin hanyoyin da suka dace na kula da dabbobi, da kuma kayan madara waɗanda suka saba sha.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba ba botšištšwego dipotšišo ba ile ba botšiošwa ka ga tsebo ya bona ya bolwetši, ge eba ba kile ba amana kgafetšakgafetša le diphoofolo, tsebo ya bona ya tlhokomelo ya maleba ya diphoofolo, le gore ke ditšweletšwa dife tša maswi tšeo ba di jago ka mehla.
Amharic: ቃለ-መጠይቅ የተደረገላቸው ሰዎች ስለበሽታው ያላቸውን እውቀት፣ ከእንስሳት ጋር አዘውትረው እንደሚገናኙ፣ ስለ ትክክለኛ የእንስሳት እንክብካቤ አሰራር ዕውቀት እና የትኞቹን የወተት ተዋጽኦዎች በብዛት እንደሚጠቀሙ ተጠይቀዋል።

Source: What the researchers found was that many of the people interviewed did not know anything about the disease, even though 40% of them owned susceptible animals.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza kye baazuula kyali nti abantu abasinga be baabuuza baali tebamanyi kantu konna ku bulwadde, wadde ng’ebitundu 40% ku bo baalina ensolo eziteeberezebwa okuba nabwo.

Hausa: Binciken ya bayar da sababbin bayanai a kan cutar da galibi ba a kula da ita a ƙasashe masu tasowa duk da illar tattalin arziki da lafiyar jama'a, kuma haɗin gwiwa ne a tsakanin masana kimiyya daga ƙasashen Masar da Australia da kuma Burtaniya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di fana ka tshedimošo ye mpsha ka ga bolwetši bjo tšeo gantši di tshedišwago mahlo ka dinageng tšeo di hlabologago ka ntle le diabe tša ekonomi le tša maphelo a setšhaba, gomme se e bile tirišano magareng ga bašomi ba tša mahlale go tšwa ka Egypt, Australia le ka United Kingdom.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና የህዝብ ጤና ችግሮች ቢያጋጥሙትም በማደግ ላይ ባሉ ሀገራት በቸልታ በሚታይ በሽታ ላይ አዲስ መረጃ የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ በግብፅ፣ አውስትራሊያ እና እንግሊዝ ሳይንቲስቶች መካከል የተደረገ ትብብር ነው።
